text: Computer Science and Technology is an interdisciplinary field that studies the design, development, application and theoretical basis of computer systems, covering the entire knowledge chain from the underlying hardware logic to the upper-level software system. Its core revolves around the essence of "computing" - how to efficiently process information, build intelligent systems, and solve practical problems. From the operating systems of smart phones to cloud computing data centers, from artificial intelligence algorithms to blockchain technology, this major is the core driving force for technological innovation in the digital age.
